silent_assassin_desc: Options for Ninja (Silent Assassin by DrTachyon)
sa_num_pagers_desc: Number of pagers allowed across all players
sa_num_pagers_per_player_desc: Number of pagers a single player may answer
sa_enabled_desc: Enable Ninja (based on Silent Assassin by DrTachyon)
sa_kill_pager_enabled_desc: If set, no pager will sound when an unalerted guard is killed in stealth
sa_local_kills_only_desc: ON = only YOUR stealth kills skip pagers. OFF = teammates get it too (host).
sa_crouch_only_desc: Stealth-kill (no pager) only if YOU are crouching. Teammate crouch cannot be read reliably.
sa_pager_bonus_enabled_desc: Enable a modified stealth bonus for missions based on pagers allowed and used.  This is EXPERIMENTAL and HOST ONLY
sa_pager_detection_threshold_desc: If detection progress meter exceeds this percentage, the pager goes off anyway
